+package chi
+
+import (
+	"log"
+	"os"
+	"sync/atomic"
+)
+
+// debugEnabled reports whether debug-level logging is turned on.
+var debugEnabled int32
+
+// debugLogger is the logger used for debug-level output.
+var debugLogger = log.New(os.Stderr, "chi: ", log.LstdFlags)
+
+// EnableDebugLogging turns on debug-level logging of route pattern
+// handling, such as pattern parsing and HTTP method detection. It is off
+// by default.
+func EnableDebugLogging() {
+	atomic.StoreInt32(&debugEnabled, 1)
+}
+
+// debugLogf writes a debug-level log line when debug logging is enabled.
+func debugLogf(format string, args ...interface{}) {
+	if atomic.LoadInt32(&debugEnabled) == 1 {
+		debugLogger.Printf("[DEBUG] "+format, args...)
+	}
+}
